card.source: 62 hero-card crops captured from a live WePoker H5 table, ground truth read from full-resolution images; 8 non-card crops (card backs, felt, obscured slots) used as negatives. Readable cards scored >= 0.664, non-cards <= 0.335, so 0.5 sits inside the observed gap. See tests/vision/test_corner_glyph_recognizer.py.
